items.title: Longineu Parsons interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 17, 2026
items.q: Beethoven studied with Haydn in his quest to learn the pen of Mozart... if you listen to early Beethoven I mean it’s hard to tell that that’s not late Haydn

ctx.x: Dmitri Shostakovich. Since I was a kid, his music has spoken to me, and now as a quote unquote scholar or whatever I am, then I really appreciate his sense of motific development. He is the twentieth century Beethoven. You know [scats] think about how far that went with those four notes, three of them being the same notes, which actually came from a Haydn piano sonata by the way.
